     Bananas are tropical fruits with soft, creamy texture and
     natural sweetness. Excellent sources of potassium and
     vitamin B6, they support heart health and provide quick
     energy. The convenient peel makes them ideal portable
     snacks. Bananas blend into smoothies, bake into breads and
     desserts, and top breakfast cereals. Available year-round
     at affordable prices, they're dietary staples globally.
❯ 3. Cherry
     Cherries are small, jewel-like fruits with glossy red or
     deep purple skin and sweet yet slightly tart flavor. Loaded
     with antioxidants and vitamin C, they support health and
     reduce inflammation. Perfect for fresh eating, baking into
     pies, or making jams. Fresh cherries have a limited growing
     season making them prized delicacies. The single pit
     inside requires careful eating but rewards with delicious
     flavor.
  4. Date
     Dates are sweet, chewy fruits growing on palm trees in
     desert climates. Naturally rich in fiber, potassium, and
     antioxidants, they provide nutrition and sustained energy.
     Enjoyed fresh, dried, or stuffed with nuts and cheese,
     dates feature in Middle Eastern and North African cuisine.
     Used in traditional dishes, desserts, and sweets, they're
     versatile for snacking and baking. Medjool and Deglet Noor
     varieties are popular choices.
